name: Immoral Report ~Joseito kara no Ecchi na Kokuhaku~
original_name: Immoral Report ～女生徒からのえっちな告白～
source:
Kenta is a student at a private academy where he is known for getting good grades, looking good, and having a great personality. Eventually he becomes the vice president. Soon his friendliness leads to both boys and girls coming up to him with their problems every day.
One day three pieces of mail came in. They were stories from three female students who felt immoral and decided to bare it all.
A girl afraid to get dirtied, a nudist, and a girl who couldn't stop masturbating.
Would he ever be able to solve their problems? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046402.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
健太是一所私立学院的学生，他以成绩好、外貌好、性格好而闻名。最终他成为副总统。很快，他的友善让男孩和女孩每天都向他提出他们的问题。
有一天，收到了三封邮件。里面是三个女学生的故事，她们感到不道德，决定将一切都揭露出来。
一个害怕弄脏的女孩，一个裸体主义者，一个无法停止自慰的女孩。
他能解决他们的问题吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046402.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
